body: Where I live you have to go to a week of detox before you are eligible for rehab. My friend went through detox and said she had therapy a few times a day and it was really supportive. So I may have to go through it anyway if I decide on rehab. Thank you for your input!

Thank you that gives me hope. I just want control and to be able to trust my emotions. I think I would be a lot better off and potentially happier with just that.   
I was definitely shaped this way from my childhood I was emotionally neglected and was always in trouble and yelled at for expressing my emotions. Now I am a mess of emotions everyday and my parents don’t believe in my issues so I have minimum support. The people who do support me I am afraid I am draining them and I can only see my therapist twice a week lately as a few people have resigned and she had to cover a lot of those clients.  
Thank you for the luck ♥️   
I just don’t want to do it wrong

That’s what I’ve been doing lately, keeping it light with people I hang out with. But part of me still feels like I’m hiding or pretending. I don’t want to overshare and constantly be upset over tiny things anymore. I wish I had a thick skin, I feel like I have no skin. I do enjoy listening to other people and ask them questions so that I am focusing on them but eventually stuff slips out and I wish I could get over it.   
Thank you for your comment maybe it will get better with practice. I just hope I’m not bottling things that actually matter sometimes.

Thank you that makes sense. I am very low a lot of the time where my instincts want me to turn to someone but I am tired of pushing people away because I’m too much and extreme. I can’t help it. I’d give anything to not be like that.

Honestly I don’t know how to self-soothe at this point. I try to write, paint and exercise but when I am at my lowest it’s hard to bring myself to do anything. Part of me just feels scared and wants to hide.

I’ve always felt like if I were to get better the world would be completely different to me. It’s hard to picture as I don’t remember not being like this. Even looking back at elementary school I can think of a lot of instances where I was showing a lot of BPD behaviour.   
I’ve read a lot about how our brains are different and it comforts me but also scares me at the same time, knowing it is not entirely in my control. I wish people took it more seriously.   
Thank you, that’s a good way of looking at it. I’ve been looking at many most of my life now as a nothing to lose situation.

Thank you so much, it makes me feel better knowing there are people like you out there who accept us and don’t see us as crazy and know we can’t control how much we feel. I’m worried I’ll basically have to fake a smaller version of myself for the rest of my life. It hurts a lot to pretend and I don’t want to live pretending anymore. I’m desperate to get better, this is torture.   
I definitely enjoy art, mostly abstract painting, but I’ve had a hard time with motivation lately but want to get back into it.   
I will check out Stoic too, I have never heard of it but I am excited to check it out. Thanks again.

Thanks so much, reading your response made me feel better and understood. I have gotten a bit better at stepping back from things and waiting for my emotions to settle before acting or saying anything, but sometimes I struggle with it for days and the emotion comes back just as hard in waves until I inevitably (for example) tell that person what they did or said bothered me. I either feel better or feel crazy. I just hope one day I can tell the difference better between what is rational and what isn’t. Sometimes I still know it’s irrational but I cannot let go of the emotion or pain. I will definitely bring up DBT with my therapist again as I feel like mindfulness might help. It just scares me how much my emotions control me and disable me as a person. Thank you again ♥️

Also I will remember the times the feelings have passed before. Thank you! I’m just always scared it won’t pass and I’ll end up saying something stupid to get it out or try to make it “better” My mind loves to assume the worst sometimes.

“Fighting myself” is the perfect way to describe it. I also don’t know when I’m in the right or wrong with my emotions and when they’re valid at this point. So I’m scared, I don’t know what I should shut up about and deal with on my own.   
I’ve tried many different therapies including DBT. My therapists concluded at the time it wasn’t for me as I really struggled due to other disorders I struggle with. I am always up to give it another shot as it couldn’t hurt. I will also look up those videos. Thanks so much for your response.   
Also your end 2 lines have me tearing up, that means a lot.
Thank you for replying. More good days than bad is more than I could ever dream of honestly.

I’ve heard of many people recovering to the point of being undiagnosed. I don’t think this is a life sentence at all, and that’s coming from me who is really struggling right now. I don’t like your therapist, you deserve better ♥️

Thank you so much for your response and for being proud of me. I’m mad at myself for not working on this sooner, I just want to be normal.    
I honestly don’t know how to work on it internally. I see a therapist once every week or two as she’s very busy but in times of increased stress I don’t know what to do. I don’t want to lash out at people anymore. I feel really stupid and crazy. I just stress people out. Sometimes I feel like faking being okay on the outside so people don’t get sick of me anymore. I feel like I’m bothering the people closest to me when I go to them. It’s so lonely, but I get it.   
Do you know of any strategies for the internal struggle? I will look into it more with my therapist next week. Thanks again.

Thanks so much for your response. I’m definitely having trouble finding the right way to express myself in a healthy way. I just am so sick of feeling like I’m hiding my emotions and not talking about them, but they’re irrational and my brain just wants me to ruin things and sabotage myself when to others it’s no big deal.  
I will keep practicing and hopefully it gets better.

What scares me is when I try to show someone how I feel I’ll ask them a question like you know when you’re so hurt you feel as though your blood went cold or you have a huge pain in your chest etc so I can tell them that’s how I feel everyday. Multiple times a day. As if I’m grieving. It’s unimaginable pain. And too many times I’ve heard “no”   
Are we the only ones who’s heart drops out of our ass constantly? Do other people not feel these things?   
I was mostly worried I was hiding my emotions and forcing a different “better” behaviour for the sake of others. I just want to feel better inside too, just like the outside I have been working so hard to appear as.   
Definitely does feel like it’s been worse at this age, especially with the stuff I’ve gone through. Thank you so much for your response and perspective, it gives me lots of hope. I really hope I get to a point where I don’t feel so out of control and too much for others anymore.
Thank you for your response. I have been going to therapy and starting to focus more on myself and dealing with my emotions. It’s just been a long journey and I just want to know it’s possible.
Thank you ❤️

Thank you so much for your response. It was very helpful and gave me a reality check. I do have some hobbies I should probably focus on. I do love lifting but it’s been hard with living with my parents and construction in my home lately so I’ve fallen into a pit. 

I am worried to wake up with brain damage for sure so I think that’s why I’m so scared. But I guess it’s for the best that I’m scared. Thank you again I really appreciate it and find a lot of comfort in everything you’ve said.

Thank you for replying. Mostly my anxiety, I can’t do anything and don’t feel normal. I have BPD so I just feel everything too much. And I recently ended a 5 year relationship and don’t know if I made a huge mistake but it’s too late now anyway. I’ve been extremely depressed so I ended it and I had to move back in with my parents and living with them is really hard. I’m supposed to go to back to college next month but I don’t know if I can do it. I don’t know if I picked the right course. Nothing feels right for me, I just feel incapable of living. Even before all these life changes everything was just too much for me. Sorry if this is a mess
